purpose: Decider for the Qwen aleatoric half-failure: is the late (L25-26) hedge log-odds gap entropy leakage into the readout, or a genuine half-verdict?
prompts: results/second_model/qwen25_7b_instruct/data/aleatoric/{prompts,controls}.jsonl, the 39 gated pairs matching jlens_trajectory.csv, chat_formatted_prompt used verbatim (md5-verified transfer)
sanity_check: mean lens log-odds gap reproduced the committed run to 3 decimals: L25 +2.421, L26 +3.674, final +6.374
experiment_B: lens decomposition of the uncertain-minus-control log-odds gap at L24-27 into hedge-side vs answer-side contributions, plus top-15 tokens by mean probability gain; files decider_expB_*.csv
experiment_C: free generation without prefill, 10 samples per prompt per arm at T=0.7, max_new_tokens 48, seeds 10000+i; repo hedge regex plus broad qualifier detector; files decider_expC_*.csv
verdict: Reading 1 (leakage). Hedge tokens hold ~1e-6 to 1e-5 probability in BOTH arms at L25-26 (no hedge decision exists to read out); the gap is produced by the generic answer channel (' the' 4.6e-3 -> 1.6e-5, ' that' 1.8e-4 -> 3.7e-6 at L26) deflating as mass spreads over concrete valid answers (top gained tokens ' February', ' Mars', ' Africa'); free-generation hedge rate 0/390 in both arms. A thin enumerative 'one of' phrasing appears on 20.5% of uncertain vs 0.5% of control completions, concentrated in 12/39 prompts and uncorrelated with the pair-level lens gap (r ~ 0.14-0.22).
environment: molab sandbox, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, torch 2.11.0+cu130, transformers 5.14.1
related_local_test: scripts/aleatoric_leakage_corr.py (per-pair corr of late log-odds gap vs entropy gap across arms, from committed jlens trajectories)
git_baseline: run against the working tree following 2448363 plus the 30 Aug mock-review fixes
